rules.justification: Exact. The replay (crates/akantu-phase-field/tests/phase_field_fixtures.rs, upstream-compat switches) asserts bit identity of every recorded nodal damage, internal force, Newton iteration count and error, dissipated energy, law internal (current and history), K entry (COO in storage order) and per-element / per-group energy: the port replicates the operation order of every phase-field kernel (dynamic-size Eigen semantics of the energy splits, fixed-size product for damage_energy * grad_d, FE products, DOF-manager assembly, Eigen sparse LU). Any difference is a defect.
rules.evidence: 2026-11-11: 30 cases, 69,902 values bitwise against the x86_64 strict oracle (akantu-oracle:dev sha256:45122c21...), replayed on aarch64 macOS and in the x86_64 Linux test image (docs/NUMERICAL_VALIDATION.md, Phase-field model); 2026-11-11: 39 cases (+ 9 adversarial rev_*, incl. upstream Newton divergences), 76,438 values bitwise; per-switch corrected replays as declared (docs/NUMERICAL_VALIDATION.md, Phase-field review fixes); an independent review (2026-11-11): the D-050-pinned regeneration of all 39 cases is byte-identical twice (1,859 files each; pin-insensitive: byte-identical under Eigen::setCpuCacheSizes(16384, 524288, 524288) + OPENBLAS_CORETYPE=Haswell, 1 thread), and 3 new adversarial cases (linear + history + volumetric_deviatoric, 1-D/2-D/3-D) replay bitwise in compat and in the corrected defaults; 2026-11-11: + dump_set_time_step (pinned install cca6e460, image sha256:2da26d87...): every dump file byte for byte (17 files) and damage / internal force bitwise (crates/akantu-phase-field/tests/pf_dump_set_time_step.rs); not a solve replay, skipped by phase_field_fixtures.rs; all 39 earlier cases regenerated byte-identically on the pinned install
